_metadata.description: OT-P0-004 — code-reference tracking and computed staleness tiers.

requirements.title: Record code references for existing and proposed code
requirements.description: Every referenced location (existing and proposed code) is captured via the machine-readable grammar ([CODE:], [REQ:]) and resolved against code-facts, so a plan declares its connected code explicitly.

validation.notes: Reference parsing + resolution behind a code-facts seam; unresolved refs are flagged not dropped; target api/internal/validation.

requirements.title: Compute staleness tiers from referenced-code change
requirements.description: Given a plan's references, compute a staleness tier — fresh, lightly-stale (small diffs in referenced code), or definitely-stale (referenced locations moved or deleted) — reusing the freshness engine's content-hash mechanism, so a plan that has sat around has a known validity.

validation.notes: Tier derivation: no change -> fresh; small diff -> lightly-stale; moved/deleted -> definitely-stale; target api/internal/validation.
